slots.notes: Fullscreen fixed object-cover background video behind all content (fixed inset-0 w-full h-full z-0); autoplays, muted, loops.
24x24 brand mark in the footer's first column, inline SVG using fill=currentColor so it inherits the white text color; sits left of the LUMINA wordmark.
Single sans typeface declared via @font-face (Helvetica Regular) and wired to Tailwind --font-sans; carries the entire page including the wordmark, link-group headings, links, and microcopy.
Bottom-bar social link glyphs (Music2, Facebook, Twitter, Youtube, Instagram), rendered at size 16 via lucide-react, tinted with currentColor at opacity-70 brightening to white on hover.

mechanic: A fixed fullscreen looping video sits behind a max-w-7xl column whose liquid-glass footer (rgba border drawn via a mask-composite gradient pseudo-element) fades and slides up on mount (opacity 0->1, y 40->0), laying the brand wordmark over a 12-column grid of three link lists above a bottom social bar.
techDelivery: Tailwind CSS v4 (@font-face wired to --font-sans) + motion/react animation spec + lucide-react icons, authored as React App.tsx / index.css.
reskinNotes: Brand wordmark is hardcoded inline SVG path data (must be swapped per brand). All copy (LUMINA name, description, the three link-list groups, the @GotInGeorgiG credit, and the Join the Journey label) is hardcoded in JSX. The liquid-glass effect and full palette are white-on-video rgba values baked into custom CSS, so reskinning to a light or non-white scheme requires editing the .liquid-glass gradient stops and inset box-shadow, not just tokens. The @font-face URL points at a third-party onlinewebfonts CDN that should be self-hosted or replaced.
